The app creates local on-device server and directs all outgoing HTTPS traffic to it. App provides locally generated trust certificate which should be installed and trusted by user to decrypt HTTPS traffic. When it is done app captures HTTPS requests, makes dummy leaf certificates for requested domains and acts as man-in-the-middle proxy to read and store data.
